scripts.deploy: npm run build && cp -R staging/* ./ && npm run deploy:preview
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npm run save
scripts.save: git add . && git commit -m "update" && git push
scripts.start: npm run build:watch & npm run start:server
scripts.update: npm install taggedjs && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js src/taggedjs/bundle.js && cp node_modules/taggedjs/bundle.js.map src/taggedjs/bundle.js.map
